targetText: Social-Democracy must change from a party of social revolution into a democratic party of social reforms.
summary: Lenin summarizes Bernstein's revisionist demand: abandoning the goal of systemic revolution in favor of piecemeal reforms within the capitalist system.
context: Bernsteinian opportunism sought to transform working-class political parties into moderate reform groups that work within existing capitalist institutions.

targetText: Without revolutionary theory there can be no revolutionary movement.
summary: Lenin asserts that practical organizing without a clear, scientifically grounded theory leads to directionless action easily manipulated by ruling class interests.
context: This fundamental principle stresses that serious political change requires rigorous study, analysis, and ideological clarity alongside day-to-day activism.
